'''''Veldt''''' was an [[Ithorian Herdship]] that travelled throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Tredo Dopra]] was chief [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] aboard the ''Veldt''.<ref name="SWTSE" />
